title: Longest Common Prefix
description:
Write a function to find the longest common prefix string shared by all strings in an array `strs`.

If there is no common prefix among the strings (or if any string in `strs` is empty), return an empty string `""`.
constraints: strs[i] consists of only lowercase English letters if it is non-empty.
hints: Compare characters column by column (vertical scanning) starting from index 0 using the first string as a reference.
Stop as soon as any string ends or has a character that differs from the reference string at the current column.
Alternatively, sorting the array means you only need to compare the lexicographically smallest and largest strings.

examples.explanation: All three strings start with "fl", and the third characters ('o', 'o', 'i') differ.
There is no common prefix among the input strings.
All three strings share the prefix "inters" before diverging at index 6.
